insight: Raised a $30M Series B led by Zeev Ventures (total funding $85M) after growing ARR 400% in 2025.
name: Reco
tagline: Security posture and threat detection for SaaS and AI agents.
description: Reco is a SaaS security platform that discovers and secures the apps, identities, and AI agents running across an organization. It maps human and non-human identities, surfaces shadow AI and misconfigurations, and detects threats across 200+ integrated applications. Its AI Agent Security adds visibility and control over autonomous agents like Copilot and Agentforce.

modelSupport.notes: Secures SaaS apps, identities, and AI agents regardless of the underlying model.

edge: Extends SaaS security posture management to AI agents, discovering and governing tools like Copilot and Agentforce alongside human identities.

references.title: Reco Raises $30 Million to Enhance AI SaaS Security
